test_load_external: test that py::module_local types registered in an external module can be loaded and cast correctly across modules
test_local_bindings: test that duplicate py::module_local class bindings with different methods work independently across two modules
test_nonlocal_failure: test that registering a non-local type in multiple modules raises a RuntimeError for duplicate registration
test_stl_bind_local: test that STL containers like LocalVec and LocalMap with module-local types support cross-module value loading
test_cross_module_calls: test cross-module calls including return_self identity, return_copy local typing, and inheritance casting with Cat and Dog
